selection_policy: Exactly 150 extraction rows from each numeric indirect source, balanced across reference forms and hard unit/value shapes with endpoint diversity.
endpoint_policy: Named standardized readouts and endpoint-defined denominators are absolute; external experimental comparators are relative; different outcomes and category codes are unavailable; unresolved points or units are unsure.
endpoint_profile_derivation: Authoritative Stage-01 canonical endpoints, routing, and deterministically resolved scalar rows; no Stage-02 dependency.

stage01_endpoint_refresh.note: The correction was decided from the authoritative endpoint and source text after a replay was launched but before any model responses were inspected.

post_v1_prompt_contract_review.policy: Apply the already-frozen prompt literally: bounds and maxima are unsure; explicit linear units conflict with log endpoints; experiment-specific enhancement factors are relative; a resolved quantity survives a separate bounded quantity.

post_v1_unit_boundary_review.policy: The frozen base prompt explicitly says a complete unit column, especially %, must be returned unchanged rather than expanded with endpoint or support context.

post_v2_endpoint_consistency_review.policy: A pEC50 value cannot retain an explicit opposite-sign log M unit; total recovery is not itself dermal absorption.

post_v2_residual_independent_review.evidence: Authoritative Stage-01 row, canonical endpoint, endpoint profile, and source/support context.
post_v2_residual_independent_review.policy: A selected percent-positive-cell readout directly measures cell-surface haptenation; an experimental comparator does not make that absolute assay readout ambiguous.
